question: Elon Musk # of tweets in September 2026?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk) posts on X during the month of September 2026.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts posts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://www.xtracker.io/. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:

Short Polymarket windows that closed by September 9 put Musk at about 27-31 counted posts per day in early September. That works out to roughly 810-930 for a 30-day month. - I found no Kalshi, Manifold or expert forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Overlapping Polymarket weekly and 3-day markets (Sept 4-11, 8-15, 10-12 and later windows) will give running reads of the pace. [predscope list](https://predscope.com/event/elon-musk-of-tweets-september-10-september-12-2026)
- The usual drivers are Musk's business news (Tesla, SpaceX, xAI, X Money) and political controversies, which have caused posting bursts before. I found no specific scheduled September catalyst.
- The tracker's handling of deleted posts and of replies that show on the main feed, plus whether the month is counted in ET or UTC, could shift the total by a few posts at bucket edges.
